note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. The before and after values are supplied configurations of equal weight; only that datum changes; every claim folder keeps its own label; nothing states a rule for joining claims, a condition, an effect or an outcome.
